title: Lost Mary BM6000 Blue Razz Cherry Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg
description: Blue Razz Cherry offers a bold berry combination that merges two popular vape flavours into one intense profile. The sweet, slightly candy-like notes of Blue Raspberry provide a sugary base that is rich and vibrant. This is layered with the deep, dark juice of Cherry, which adds a sophisticated tartness and depth, creating a complex and highly satisfying fruit blend. Designed for use with the Lost Mary BM6000 V2 Prefilled Pod Kit , this pack includes a replaceable 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container, allowing you to refresh your device with ease. This system extends the lifespan of your device, providing up to 6000 puffs while offering the flexibility to switch flavours at any time. How To Setup Lost Mary BM6000 Pod & Refill Step 1 Remove the prefilled pod and refill container from the packaging. Step 2 Remove any safety stickers from the components. Step 3 Insert the pod securely into the device. Step 4 Attach the refill container to the side of the device. Step 5 Turn the device upside down to transfer e-liquid from the refill container to the pod. Step 6 Allow a few minutes for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set! When the pod and refill container are empty, simply replace them with a new set to continue enjoying your Lost Mary BM6000 V2 device.
